description: Analytical-reliability core: fix the exported m3_corporate_structure.json v2.0 output contract (de-wrap from the refined_structure wrapper so root = schema_version/artifact_type/visual_spec/companies, matching examples/bo_m3/Sample HCA Corp Structure Final Output.json; move provenance+audit to a governed sidecar m3_structure_provenance.json), and HARDEN Validator 7 + the senior-management reasoning: completion-status consistency, rejected material findings excluded from the authoritative conclusion while retained in the audit trail, the explicit credibility-vs-credit-direction distinction, and citation-id-existence-is-not-entailment. All schema changes additive/versioned/backward-compatible. This feature must be completed before FEAT-002 because the standalone runner consumes the corrected deliverables and validator. Independent of FEAT-003 (tests) except that FEAT-003 verifies it.
steps: In app/services/bo/m3_artifacts.py, add build_m3_corporate_structure_export(structure) returning the refined v2.0 payload AT ROOT (the dict already in structure.refined_structure: schema_version, artifact_type, purpose, how_to_use, visual_spec, companies, generated_by, and simulation_disclaimer when present) with NO artifact_kind/refined_structure wrapper. Return None when structure.status != 'available' or refined_structure is falsy (fail-closed, unchanged).

In app/services/bo/m3_artifacts.py, add build_m3_structure_sidecar(structure) returning the governed internal record: artifact_kind=M3_STRUCTURE_ARTIFACT_KIND, artifact_id=_structure_artifact_id(structure) (keep the SAME stable id derivation so Deliverable B's reference is unchanged), is_simulated, provenance (model_dump), roundtrip_reconciliation, document_hash and transform_version pulled from provenance. Keep _structure_artifact_id unchanged.

In app/services/bo/m3_artifacts.py, update build_m3_deliverables to return {'m3_corporate_structure': build_m3_corporate_structure_export(structure) (de-wrapped A, None if unavailable), 'm3_structure_sidecar': build_m3_structure_sidecar(structure) (None if unavailable), 'm3_analysis': build_m3_analysis_artifact(...)}. build_m3_analysis_artifact's corporate_structure_reference.artifact_id must still equal the sidecar artifact_id (pass the sidecar, or recompute via _structure_artifact_id). Keep the old build_m3_corporate_structure_artifact importable (thin alias to the sidecar builder) so nothing else breaks; add a deprecation note in its docstring.
In app/services/bo/completion.py::_module_conclusions, attach out['M3']['m3_structure_sidecar'] = deliverables['m3_structure_sidecar'] alongside m3_corporate_structure and m3_analysis.

In app/services/bo/completion.py::write_completion_artifacts, write m3_corporate_structure.json from the de-wrapped export (root = v2.0 shape) and, when a validated structure exists, write m3_structure_provenance.json from m3_structure_sidecar. m3_analysis.json unchanged (always written). SVG stays optional and never replaces Deliverable A.

In app/services/bo/m3_output.py::_completion_status (and _section_c), make status 'incomplete' when BOTH section A is unavailable AND section B is not assessed, and NEVER return 'complete' unless A is available AND B is assessed. Preserve the existing 'partial' case (A unavailable, B assessed). Keep direction/verification/availability in separate fields; keep forced_outcome False and requires_human_review True.

In app/services/bo/m3_artifacts.py::build_m3_analysis_artifact, ensure consolidated_conclusion and material_credit_implications draw ONLY from findings whose disposition is not 'rejected' (and not material-level 'unverified'), while evidence_verification (validation_issues + rejected_items) retains EVERY rejected/unresolved item. Surface a human-review-required disposition in section C where the existing Disposition enum supports it; do NOT add new enum values if avoidable; do NOT force equal pos/neg counts.

In app/schemas/bo_m3.py, add ADDITIVELY to ManagementObservation (model_config extra='forbid', so new fields must have defaults): credit_direction: Direction = Direction.NEUTRAL and credibility_vs_direction_note: str | None = None (import Direction from app.schemas.bo). These make the credibility(disposition) vs credit-direction distinction explicit and machine-checkable. Do not change existing fields, the schema_version literal, or validator_id.

In app/services/bo/m3_validation.py::_govern_finding (management_assessments branch), preserve credit_direction SEPARATELY from disposition: a credible explanation (disposition supported/qualified) must NEVER flip an adverse observation's credit_direction to positive/neutral. When an item explains an adverse development credibly, record a validation reason (and set credibility_vs_direction_note) stating credibility does not change credit direction. Do not force any direction; only prevent credibility from laundering a negative into a positive.

In app/services/bo/m3_validation.py, where evidence_texts is available, route material management/structural claims asserting a specific value/period/entity through semantic_entailment.DeterministicCheck numeric/period/entity checks ONLY (no live model). On a deterministic mismatch, downgrade disposition to 'unverified'/'rejected' with a recorded reason; where semantic entailment cannot be deterministically established, keep the existing conservative disposition + limitation + human-review rather than claiming verification (citation-id existence is NOT entailment). Reuse DeterministicCheck/SemanticAssessment from app/services/bo/semantic_entailment.py.
acceptance_criteria: The in-memory build_m3_deliverables()['m3_corporate_structure'] for the HCA simplified input has root keys schema_version, artifact_type, visual_spec, companies (and purpose/how_to_use/generated_by/simulation_disclaimer) and does NOT contain a top-level 'refined_structure' or 'artifact_kind' key; its root key SET matches the reference Sample HCA Corp Structure Final Output.json root keys for schema_version/artifact_type/visual_spec/companies.

build_m3_deliverables()['m3_structure_sidecar'] carries artifact_id, provenance and roundtrip_reconciliation, and m3_analysis['corporate_structure_reference']['artifact_id'] equals the sidecar artifact_id.
write_completion_artifacts writes a de-wrapped m3_corporate_structure.json plus m3_structure_provenance.json when a structure is available, and only m3_analysis.json when it is not.
A run with A unavailable and B unavailable yields completion status 'incomplete' (never 'complete'); A unavailable + B assessed stays 'partial'; A available + B assessed is 'complete'.
A rejected material management finding appears in m3_analysis evidence_verification.rejected_items but NOT in consolidated_conclusion.

ManagementObservation accepts credit_direction and credibility_vs_direction_note with defaults, and a credibly-explained adverse observation retains a negative credit_direction (not flipped) with a recorded credibility_vs_direction_note.
A management claim citing a real evidence id but with a mismatched number/period is downgraded (not accepted); a faithful claim is retained.

The targeted M3 suite passes after FEAT-001's own test updates: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py tests/unit/test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py -q
verification: Update the two existing tests that encode the OLD wrapped shape (contract CORRECTION, not weakening): tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py::test_both_deliverables_written_to_disk_when_available (assert structure['schema_version']=='2.0' and structure['companies'] at ROOT; assert m3_structure_provenance.json exists; assert B.corporate_structure_reference.artifact_id == sidecar artifact_id) and tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py::test_deliverables_structure_and_analysis_linked_when_available (assert de-wrapped root on m3_corporate_structure; sidecar carries provenance+roundtrip).

Run: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py tests/unit/test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py -q  and confirm all pass (baseline was 55 passed).
Import check: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -c "import app.services.bo.m3_artifacts, app.services.bo.completion, app.services.bo.m3_output, app.services.bo.m3_validation, app.schemas.bo_m3"
findings:
DE-WRAPPED EXPORT (Deliverable A): build_m3_deliverables(structure, governed_m3, m3_output)['m3_corporate_structure'] is now the refined v2.0 payload AT ROOT (None when unavailable). Root keys: schema_version, artifact_type, purpose, how_to_use, visual_spec, companies, generated_by, and simulation_disclaimer (present for simulated HCA). NO 'refined_structure'/'artifact_kind' wrapper. Builder: app.services.bo.m3_artifacts.build_m3_corporate_structure_export(structure)->dict|None.

SIDECAR (governed internal record): build_m3_deliverables(...)['m3_structure_sidecar'] (None when unavailable). Builder: build_m3_structure_sidecar(structure)->dict|None. Fields: artifact_kind='m3_corporate_structure', artifact_id (=_structure_artifact_id(structure), UNCHANGED stable derivation), is_simulated, provenance (CorporateStructureProvenance.model_dump), roundtrip_reconciliation, document_hash, transform_version. Written to file m3_structure_provenance.json by completion.write_completion_artifacts ONLY when m3_corporate_structure is also written (i.e. structure available). Deliverable B's corporate_structure_reference.artifact_id == sidecar artifact_id. Legacy build_m3_corporate_structure_artifact kept as a thin alias to build_m3_structure_sidecar (deprecated).

FILES WRITTEN by write_completion_artifacts (keys in returned paths dict): m3_corporate_structure.json (de-wrapped A), m3_structure_provenance.json (sidecar, only with A), m3_analysis.json (B, always). completion._module_conclusions now also sets out['M3']['m3_structure_sidecar'].

ManagementObservation NEW additive fields (app.schemas.bo_m3, extra='forbid', defaults): credit_direction: Direction = Direction.NEUTRAL; credibility_vs_direction_note: str | None = None. Direction imported from app.schemas.bo. schema_version/validator_id unchanged.

VALIDATOR 7 (m3_validation): _govern_finding signature now _govern_finding(raw, *, allowed, borrower_known, issues, bucket, evidence_texts=None). A credible (supported/qualified) adverse (negative/mixed) management observation keeps its credit_direction and gets a credibility_vs_direction_note + issue rule 'm3.credibility_vs_direction'. New deterministic entailment gate: _deterministic_claim_checks(claim_text, evidence_ids, evidence_texts) using semantic_entailment.DeterministicCheck; a claimed number/period absent from cited evidence text -> disposition 'rejected' (contradiction) with issue rule 'm3.deterministic_entailment'; empty when nothing machine-checkable (conservative disposition retained; citation-id != entailment).

ANALYSIS (Deliverable B) consolidated_conclusion now carries admitted_management_signal_ids / admitted_governance_signal_ids / admitted_structural_signal_ids plus disposition='human_review_required'; only admitted findings feed it. evidence_verification gained excluded_from_conclusion_ids and still retains ALL rejected_items/validation_issues. Admission gate helper: m3_artifacts._is_admitted(signal) excludes disposition=='rejected', assessment_availability=='insufficient_evidence', and material-level (high/medium) disposition=='unverified'.

m3_output._completion_status: 'complete' ONLY if A available AND B assessed; 'partial' if B assessed/insufficient but A unavailable (or A available + B insufficient); 'incomplete' otherwise. forced_outcome False, requires_human_review True preserved.

TESTS CORRECTED (contract, not weakened): tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py::test_both_deliverables_written_to_disk_when_available (root schema_version/companies, no wrapper, m3_structure_provenance.json exists, B.ref==sidecar id); tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py::test_deliverables_structure_and_analysis_linked_when_available (de-wrapped A root, sidecar carries provenance+roundtrip). Targeted suite 55 passed; full offline suite 1384 passed / 131 skipped / 12 known pre-existing errors (untracked output/ dir), zero new failures.
